metadata.title: kthvalue incorrect with strided GPU tensor

bug_description: torch.kthvalue produces incorrect values and indices when the input tensor is a strided CUDA tensor.

trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.kthvalue on a tensor created through slicing with non-contiguous memory layout.

failure_behavior.description: The returned kth value and index are incorrect compared with the expected result.

root_cause_information.description: The bug is related to incorrect handling of tensors with non-standard memory strides.
